notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes/Patches[/h2]

- fixed via workaround for known engine issue regarding flag's cloth when changing arenas (patched in version 1.0.4, resolved)

- Patched issue where the flag or shovel could be hovering a cube but the "connector pipes" would not show (was especially prevalent with Subgrids' calibration set to small cube sizes)

- fixed issue where exiting Calibration Menu didn't immediately save the new calibration and player's change to grid size/height could be lost if the game was restarted immediately after completing calibration

[h2]Additions/Improvements[/h2]

- Changed UI text of "medium" graphics quality setting to "standard"

- Improved Arenas Beach Scene (campaign mode) & Warehouse Arenas. Water updated on both arenas!!

- improved beach ambiance (the sound could barely be heard, turned up slightly)

- Made menus more energy efficient. The menu decorations now receive less energy. The cubes may flicker now as they were not designed for low energy states (this effect is not visible on low graphics quality settings)

- Added Zivraye's raft to the Beach Scene campaign levels

- improved accuracy of flag hand selection sensor when selecting cubes in Subgrids

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
Fixes/Patches

- fixed issue where Profile > Unlockables when applying to Flag top/bottom would affect both instead of the selected

notes.title: Price Change
notes.content:
Seasons greetings! After careful consideration -or perhaps just too much eggnog- we've decided to halve all in-game prices!

This includes the "All Arenas Bundle" (full game experience) price, which gives you all background Arenas current & future at today's pricing. Future Arenas will likely not be part of the campaign and may require purchasing (individually or bundled) as the only way to access those Arenas. If you own the bundle when new Arenas are released you will receive these arenas at no additional cost as we release them!!!

The plan for the bundle pricing has not changed: it will increase with the addition of future Arenas (and likely the overall maturity of the game as well) . However, we feel that the previous price points would have quickly limited the maximum number of Arenas that could reasonable be added without drastically bloating the bundle's total price. For this reason we've decided to scale it back!

This update also resolves the issue where in-game prices were shown as "( $ ERR )" and now, instead, will properly present the localized price (where appropriate) as-is from Steam.

Please note:
[list]
[*] this is a permanent change and not a sale
[*] this does not affect players ability to enjoy the game modes (including the campaign) for free
[*] The Zivraye Group reserves the right to change the price at any time and for any reason
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes/Patches[/h2]

- fixed Options menu's tab bar slightly overlapping the Subvirtual title text

[h2]Additions/Improvements[/h2]

- Changed the safety warning/agreement at startup. There is now a checkbox that won't show the warning/agreement again until it is updated

- Added "About" section to Profile Panel as a tab. From here credits menu is linked, the Startup Safety Warning menu is linked, and external link to our webpage with some basic information about Zivraye's Universe is also linked

- added "retry" button to the "VR Interface Not Found" error menu. This menu may show up if VR failed to start or the game started too fast or the VR headset has become disconnected before startup. The retry button should be used after ensuring VR is up and running and will detect the VR interface at this menu now instead of requiring the player to restart the game (as was the case before). Note: quit btn still available at this menu to exit & restart anyway if desirable

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes/Patches[/h2]

- patched an issue where changing Arenas could crash the game seemingly at random

- fixed Profile > Stats showing Best Times first instead of General Stats

- fixed issue where Memory Test & Bomb Sniffers' Best Times would always display Custom Mode's Best Times

- fixed issue with end game screen's "New Match" button. Button would not always create a match similar to the previous match

- fixed menu title not matching Subvirtual theme

- fixed beach chair cloth, on Beach Scene Arena, not rendering the back of the cloth

[h2]Additions/Improvements[/h2]

- Options > Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Added cube shell density slider (adjusts transparency of uncovered cubes)
[*] Added cube shell energy slider (adjusts glow of uncovered cubes)
[/list]
- Optimized default stats data for new stats

- Added in-game menu opening/closing effects

- improved overall balance of some SFX when compared to the volume of others

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes/Patches[/h2]

- fixes an issue where the player's inventory could be retrieved too early/fast resulting in it being incorrectly empty in-game.

- patched issue where changing Options > Video > Graphics Quality while the game was running would cause the game to become unstable. High graphics option is now re-enabled in settings. [u]Warning[/u]: low spec graphics cards may cause motion sickness on high graphics quality setting, use with caution

- fixed issue where shadows weren't rendered on most Arenas (setting graphics quality to low will still result in shadows being disabled intentionally)

- fixed pole object rendering inside out. Inverted normals + back face culling resulted in the player seeing the inside of this object from the outside


[h2]Additions/Improvements[/h2]

- added Best Times section to Profile > Stats. The stats now flip between the original general stats and the best times lists using buttons at the bottom right & left of the stats section

- added The Zivraye Group's official logo to the initial startup menu

- improved Warehouse Arena efficiency

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes/Patches[/h2]
- Fixed "Cradle Da Floof!" Achievement. Incorrectly had level 9 shown instead of the correct: level 10 without failing.

[h2]Additions/Improvements[/h2]
Adjusted the following menus to better fit the game's theme:
  - Change Arenas (accessible from the main menu)
  - Achievements In-Game (accessible from profile panel)
  - Music Credits (accessible from credits menu)
